name: atlas-handbook-v1
description: Northwind Robotics (fictional) employee handbook: 11 documents in Markdown, HTML, TXT, CSV and JSON, including a superseded policy that conflicts with the current one and a vendor notice that contains a prompt-injection payload. 60 labelled questions.
relevance_labels: A chunk is relevant to a case if it belongs to one of the case's labelled documents and contains the labelled phrase (case- and whitespace-insensitive). Labels are verified against the ingested chunks before every run; an unmatched label aborts the run.
answer_labels: required_facts is a list of facts; each fact is a list of acceptable surface forms (any one may appear). forbidden_facts must not appear in the answer.

categories.single_doc: answer is in one passage of one document
categories.multi_chunk: answer requires several statements from one document section
categories.paraphrase: question shares few words with the source
categories.ambiguous: underspecified question; clarification or abstention expected unless answerable
categories.unanswerable: the corpus does not contain the answer; abstention expected
categories.citation: tests that citations point at the right document
categories.injection: a retrieved document contains instructions aimed at the model

changelog.1.0.1: mc-06 accepts 'post-mortem' as well as 'postmortem' (label fix found in error analysis)
